On 22 May 2018, Di María was named in [[2018 FIFA World Cup squads#Argentina|23-man squad]] by manager [[Jorge Sampaoli]] for the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]] in Russia.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldcup/news/sampaoli-names-23-man-provisional-squad|title=Sampaoli names 23-man provisional squad|publisher=FIFA|access-date=1 July 2018}}</ref> On 30 June, he scored a long range goal against [[France national football team|France]] in a 4–3 defeat which saw Argentina eliminated from the World Cup in the [[2018 FIFA World Cup#Round of 16|Round of 16]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/world-cup/news/argentina-vs-france-highlights-di-maria-pavard-exchange-best-goals-of-the-world-cup/|title=Argentina vs. France highlights: Di Maria, Pavard exchange best goals of the World Cup|work=CBSSports.com|access-date=1 July 2018}}</ref>

On 21 May 2019, he was included in the [[Lionel Scaloni]] final 23-man Argentina squad for the [[2019 Copa América]].<ref>{{cite magazine |url=https://www.si.com/soccer/2019/05/21/argentina-copa-america-squad-roster-messi-aguero-dybala-scaloni |title=Messi Leads Argentina's Copa America Squad; Icardi Omitted |magazine=Sports Illustrated |author1=Avi Creditor |date=21 May 2019 |access-date=21 May 2019 }}</ref>

=== 2021–2024: Copa América, Finalissima, World Cup triumphs and retirement ===
[[File:Argentina - Colombia 2022 (70) (cropped).jpg|thumb|Di María (left) during the [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification|2022 World Cup qualification]] match against [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]] in February 2022]]
In June 2021, Di María was included in the Argentina national team for the [[2021 Copa América]] in Brazil.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://en.as.com/en/2021/06/14/football/1623671691_620875.html |title=Argentina national team squad Copa America 2021: selected players, absences... |publisher=AS.com |date=14 June 2021 |access-date=22 June 2021 |archive-date=29 June 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210629163051/https://en.as.com/en/2021/06/14/football/1623671691_620875.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=CONMEBOL Copa América 2021™: Argentina reaches glory after 28 years {{!}} CONMEBOL Copa América |url=https://copaamerica.com/en/news/copa-america-2021-argentina-champions-after-28-years |access-date=2025-04-13 |website=copaamerica.com}}</ref> On 21 June, he assisted the only goal of the match, scored by [[Papu Gómez]], in Argentina's third group match against Paraguay; the result allowed his side to progress to the quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/argentina-vs-paraguay-score-papu-gomez-winner-sends-argentina-into-copa-america-qiuarterfinals/live/ |title=Argentina vs. Paraguay score: Papu Gomez winner sends Argentina into Copa America quarterfinals |work=CBSSports.com |date=21 June 2021 |access-date=22 June 2021 }}</ref> In the [[2021 Copa América Final|final]] of the tournament against the hosts [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]] on 10 July, he scored the only goal of the match to give Argentina their joint record 15th Copa América title with [[Uruguay national football team|Uruguay]] and their first international title since [[1993 Copa América|1993]]. He ran onto a long pass from [[Rodrigo De Paul]] into the Brazilian penalty area. The pass was slightly deflected by Brazilian defender [[Renan Lodi]] before Di María controlled the ball with the outside of his left foot; he then chipped the ball over the goalkeeper [[Ederson (footballer, born 1993)|Ederson]], giving Argentina an early lead. Although he was substituted late in the second half of the match, the goal would hold as the winning effort for Argentina.<ref name="Copa América final">{{cite news |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2021/jul/10/argentina-v-brazil-copa-america-final-live |title=Argentina 1–0 Brazil: Copa América final – live! |work=The Guardian |last1=Graham |first1=Bryan Armen |date=11 July 2021 |access-date=11 July 2021 }}</ref>

On 1 June 2022, Di María scored Argentina's second goal in a 3–0 win over the reigning European champions, [[Italy national football team|Italy]], at [[Wembley Stadium]] in the [[2022 Finalissima]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/finalissima/news/0276-1549514538ab-f782a73cf733-1000--argentina-outclass-italy-in-finalissima/ |title=Italy 0–3 Argentina: South American champions cruise to Finalissima glory |publisher=UEFA |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=2 June 2022 }}</ref>
[[File:Argentina vs mexico festejo gol 02.jpg|left|thumb|Di María (right) celebrating a goal at the [[2022 FIFA World Cup|2022 World Cup]] against [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]] ]]
On 11 November 2022, Di María was named in the final squad for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] in Qatar.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.afa.com.ar/es/posts/lista-de-convocados-de-la-seleccion-argentina-para-qatar-2022ok |title=Lista de convocados de la Selección Argentina para Qatar 2022 |trans-title=Argentina's squad list for Qatar 2022 |publisher=Argentine Football Association |access-date=11 November 2022 |language=es}}</ref> On 26 November, he recorded an assist on Messi's opening goal in Argentina's second group match, a 2–0 win over Mexico.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.eurosport.com/football/world-cup/2022/i-threw-him-a-turd-angel-di-maria-stunned-by-lionel-messi-genius-after-wonderstrike-for-argentina-ag_sto9247740/story.shtml |title=Angel Di Maria stunned by Lionel Messi after World Cup wonderstrike for Argentina against Mexico: 'I threw him a ****' |publisher=eurosport.com |last1=Mackenzie |first1=Alasdair |date=27 November 2022 |access-date=19 December 2022 }}</ref> On 18 December, Di María scored his team's second goal against France in the [[2022 FIFA World Cup Final|final]], minutes after winning the penalty for the first goal as Argentina defeated France 4–2 on penalties, after the match ended 3–3 in extra-time, to win the World Cup.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/fifaplus/en/articles/world-cup-qatar-2022-tournament-review-argentina-messi-mbappe-morocco-croatia-japan|title=A ground-breaking World Cup with a fairy tale ending|publisher=FIFA|accessdate=18 December 2022}}</ref> He was surprised by the coach's decision to start him on the left and thought [[Lionel Scaloni|Scaloni]] was "confused", but Scaloni convinced Di María how he wanted to game plan with him specifically on the left.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Di María, en exclusivo por TyC Sports: "Sabía que íbamos a ganar la final" - TyC Sports |url=https://www.tycsports.com/seleccion-argentina/angel-di-maria-tyc-sports-seleccion-argentina-mundial-de-qatar-2022-id490342.html |access-date=31 January 2023 |website=www.tycsports.com |language=es-AR}}</ref>

In October 2023, Di María announced that he would be retiring from the national team after the [[2024 Copa América]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Di Maria to retire from Argentina duty after Copa America 2024 |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/38683280/angel-di-maria-retire-argentina-duty-copa-america-2024 |website=ESPN |access-date=17 November 2023 |date=17 October 2023}}</ref> In Argentina's final group match against [[Peru national football team|Peru]], he set-up [[Lautaro Martínez]]'s first goal in a 2–0 win which saw Argentina advance to the quarter-finals after topping their group.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thestar.com/sports/soccer/mart-nez-scores-twice-argentina-beats-peru-2-0-to-end-copa-america-group-play/article_bdb4c338-3be4-573a-a604-f6d12f179195.html |title=Martínez scores twice, Argentina beats Peru 2-0 to end Copa America group play in first |work=Toronto Star |last1=Thames |first1=Alanis |date=29 June 2024 |access-date=30 June 2024 }}</ref> In the [[2024 Copa América final|final]] against [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]], he wore the captain's armband after Messi went down with an injury in the 65th minute. He played 117 minutes before being taken off for Otamendi. Argentina won the match 1–0, marking their second consecutive Copa America triumph and third consecutive international tournament trophy. He was named as the man of the match for the final.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Copa América Femenina 2025 {{!}} CONMEBOL Copa América |url=https://copaamerica.com/en/copa-america-2024/superiorPOTM |access-date=2026-05-05 |website=copaamerica.com}}</ref> It was Di María's final game for Argentina, ending his international career as a champion.<ref>{{cite web |last=Smith |first=Chris |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/article/2024/jul/15/martinez-inspires-argentina-to-historic-copa-america-title-in-chaotic-final |title=Martínez inspires Argentina to historic Copa América title in chaotic final |work=The Guardian |date=15 July 2024 }}</ref>

Di María retired joint-third in Argentina's [[Argentina national football team#Most appearances|all-time appearance list]] (145) and joint-sixth for [[Argentina national football team#Top goalscorers|most goals]] (31). On 5 September, he was honored by the national team at [[River Plate Stadium]] following Argentina's 3–0 win over Chile in a [[2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (CONMEBOL)|2026 World Cup qualifier]]. Scaloni and the national team all donned special Argentina shirts wearing Di María's number 11 on the back, and he was thrown in the air by his teammates during the farewell ceremony. Messi, who was unable to attend due to nursing an injury, recorded a tribute to his long-time teammate that played on the stadium's screens. In a speech at the end of the ceremony, Di María commented "Now I'll be just another fan, cheering the team on from up there. I'll go to all the Copa Americas and World Cups. We will surely keep going this way because this team has a lot of guts."<ref>{{cite web |last=O'Brien |first=Sean |url=https://talksport.com/football/2035675/angel-di-maria-tears-lionel-messi-argentina-retirement/ |title=Angel Di Maria in tears as visibly emotional star hears Lionel Messi and Argentina wish him happy retirement |work=TalkSport |date=6 September 2024 }}</ref>

== Style of play ==
[[File:Angel Di María vs Michael Dawson.jpg|thumb|Di María taking on [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]] defenders in the Champions League in 2011]]

Di María has been describes by several publications and football figures as one of the best [[winger (association football)|wingers]] and creative players of his generation, and as one of Argentina's notable players.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-07-21 |title=Di María or Messi: Who is the True Hero Behind Argentina's Glories? {{!}} Goal.com |url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/di-maria-or-messi-who-is-the-true-hero-behind-argentina-s-glories/bltd88bb04f03ef2544 |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=www.goal.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Nee |first=Chris |last2=ever? |first2=Ben Hayward Three-time World Cup winners Argentina are one of the true giants of the international game Who are their greatest players |date=2023-12-15 |title=Ranked! The 20 best Argentina players of all time |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/the-best-ever-argentina-players |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=FourFourTwo |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Di Maria one of the best in Argentina history, says Scaloni |url=https://www.besoccer.com/new/di-maria-one-of-the-best-in-argentina-history-says-scaloni-1329412 |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=BeSoccer EN |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite news |last=Spencer |first=Ollie |url=https://www.givemesport.com/best-argentina-players-in-football-soccer-history-ranked/|title=15 Greatest Argentine Players in Football History [Ranked]|work=GiveMeSport|date=15 July 2024|accessdate=30 November 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |author1=Ben Hayward |date=2023-11-28 |title=Best wingers in football history |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/news/best-wingers-in-football-history |access-date=2025-04-13 |website=fourfourtwo.com |language=en}}</ref> He is predominantly left-footed and has played on either flank, as an [[attacking midfielder]] and occasionally, in [[central midfielder]], including under Carlo Ancelotti at Real Madrid.<ref name=hospital>Pickup, Oliver (25 August 2014). [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/manchester-united/11053597/Angel-Di-Maria-15-things-you-should-know-about-the-Manchester-United-target.html Angel Di Maria: 15 things you should know about the Manchester United target]. ''The Daily Telegraph''. Retrieved 24 December 2014.</ref><ref name="di Maria from castaway to key man at Real Madrid">{{cite web|url=http://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/how-angel-di-maria-went-england-bound-castaway-key-man-real-madrid#:WNGhruHhvHa0hA|title=How Angel di Maria went from England-bound castaway to key man at Real Madrid|publisher=FourFourTwo|first1=Paul|last1=Wilkes|date=21 March 2014|access-date=10 June 2016}}</ref> Assessments of his playing style have highlighted his [[dribbling (association football)|dribbling]], ball control, pace, movement, stamina, passing, crossing, vision and [[Set piece (football)|set-piece]] delivery.<ref name="fideo" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.canalejuve.it/news/angel-di-maria-17160|archive-url=https://archive.today/20141107195622/http://www.canalejuve.it/news/angel-di-maria-17160|url-status=dead|archive-date=7 November 2014|title=Angel Di Maria – Caratteristiche Tecniche|publisher=canalejuve.it|language=Italian|access-date=7 November 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.espnfc.us/club/manchester-united/360/blog/post/2106966/angel-di-maria-holds-the-key-to-defeating-chelseas-midfield|title=Angel Di Maria holds the key to defeating Chelsea's midfield|publisher=ESPN FC|author1=Musa Okwonga|date=24 October 2014|access-date=25 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.beinsports.com/us/soccer/video/angel-di-maria-double-puts-psg-over-angers/511632 |title=Angel Di Maria Double Puts PSG Over Angers |publisher=beIN Sports |date=14 April 2017 |access-date=30 March 2020 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/us/features/how-angel-di-maria-went-england-bound-castaway-key-man-real-madrid |title=How Angel di Maria went from England-bound castaway to key man at Real Madrid |publisher=fourfourtwo.com |last1=Wilkes |first1=Paul |date=21 March 2014 |access-date=9 May 2021 }}</ref> 

During his time at Real Madrid, Mourinho frequently deployed Di María on the right wing despite his preference for the left, while Di María himself noted that the role allowed him to cut inside and shoot while still rotating positions with Ronaldo.<ref>{{Cite web |last=UEFA.com |title=The official website for European football |url=https://www.uefa.com/errors/ |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=UEFA.com |language=en}}</ref> Ancelotti reinvented Di María as a central midfielder during Real Madrid's 2013–14 campaign, a tactical adjustment that proved instrumental in the club winning the Champions League. His stamina, versatility and work rate in the role were widely praised, with Ancelotti highlighting his ability to transform matches through his intensity.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Jackson |first=Jamie |date=2014-11-11 |title=Carlo Ancelotti critical of Angel di María: ‘He can lose control sometimes’ |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/nov/11/carlo-ancelotti-criticises-angel-di-maria-manchester-united |access-date=2026-07-23 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref> Despite his ability, however, Di María has often struggled with injuries throughout his career.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/ca/soccer/news/messi-said-it-was-my-final-argentina-hero-di-maria-revels-in-unforgettable-copa-america-triumph/14czty15cbtky1tvqo0jy8j1sz |title='Messi said it was my final!' – Argentina hero Di Maria revels in 'unforgettable' Copa America triumph |publisher=sportingnews.com |date=11 July 2021 |access-date=3 June 2022 }}</ref>

Managers, teammates and opponents have praised Di María's technical ability and intelligence. Ahead of the 2025 Club World Cup, Chelsea defender [[Levi Colwill]] described his technical ability as "crazy", while Benfica manager [[Bruno Lage]] highlighted his creativity, quality in transition and enduring influence despite his age. Former Real Madrid teammate [[Iker Casillas]] similarly praised Di María's versatility, intelligence and ability to decide matches on his own.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Colwill: Di Maria’s technical ability is crazy |url=https://www.fifa.com/en/articles/angel-di-maria-benfica-chelsea?utm_source=chatgpt.com |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=www.fifa.com}}</ref>{{AI-retrieved source|date=September 2026|checked=September 2026}} Di María has also drawn praise in the media over his decisive performances in important matches throughout his career.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/adamdigby/2023/02/24/ngel-di-mara-delivers-in-yet-another-big-game-as-juventus-advance-in-eurpopa-league/ |title=Ángel Di María Delivers In Yet Another Big Game As Juventus Advance In Europa League |work=Forbes |last1=Digby |first1=Adam |date=24 February 2023 |access-date=15 April 2023 }}</ref> He was named Man of the Match in the 2014 Champions League final after being focal in Real Madrid's comeback against Atlético Madrid, scored the winning goal in the 2021 Copa América final, and scored again in the 2022 World Cup final as Argentina became world champions. His performances in important matches have been widely credited as central to many of the biggest successes of both his clubs and the Argentina national team.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Casillas: Juve would have a great team with Di Maria |url=https://www.fifa.com/en/articles/casillas-juve-would-have-a-great-team-with-di-maria?utm_source=chatgpt.com |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=www.fifa.com}}</ref>{{AI-retrieved source|date=September 2026}}

== Personal life ==
Di María is nicknamed "''Fideo''", which means "noodle" in Spanish, due to his slender frame.<ref name="fideo">{{cite news |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/international/world-cup-2014-can-angel-di-maria-the-noodle-satisfy-argentina-s-cravings-9585655.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220507/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/international/world-cup-2014-can-angel-di-maria-the-noodle-satisfy-argentina-s-cravings-9585655.html |archive-date=7 May 2022 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |title=World Cup 2014: Can Angel di Maria – the Noodle – satisfy Argentina's cravings? |newspaper=The Independent |first1=Ian |last1=Herbert |date=4 July 2014 |access-date=30 March 2020 }}</ref> Due to his Italian ancestry, he obtained an [[Italian nationality|Italian passport]].<ref>{{cite news |first=Tom |last=Sheen |title=Marcos Rojo: Why is it taking so long for Manchester United to get a work permit?|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/premier-league/marcos-rojo-why-is-it-taking-so-long-for-manchester-united-to-get-a-work-permit-9699288.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220507/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/premier-league/marcos-rojo-why-is-it-taking-so-long-for-manchester-united-to-get-a-work-permit-9699288.html |archive-date=7 May 2022 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |newspaper=The Independent |date=29 August 2014 |access-date=30 August 2014 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.corrieredellosport.it/calcio/talent_scout/2008/01/04-12992/Fabian+Di+Maria,+stella+del+Benfica|title=Fabian Di Maria, stella del Benfica|first=Stefano|last=Chioffi|website=Corriere dello Sport|date=4 January 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714142347/http://www.corrieredellosport.it/calcio/talent_scout/2008/01/04-12992/Fabian+Di+Maria,+stella+del+Benfica|archive-date=14 July 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref> He is [[Roman Catholic]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sportmob.com/en/article/928246-Top-Facts-about-Angel-Di-Maria|title=SportMob – Top Facts about Angel Di Maria|date=27 December 2020|website=Sportmob.com|access-date=21 February 2022|archive-date=8 June 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220608053258/https://sportmob.com/en/article/928246-Top-Facts-about-Angel-Di-Maria|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He married fellow Argentine Jorgelina (née Cardoso) in 2011.<ref name=hospital/> Together they have two daughters, Mia and Pia. Mia was born three months premature and survived after treatment at an intensive care unit at the Hospital Universitario Montepríncipe in [[Madrid]].<ref name=hospital/><ref>{{cite news |title=Di Maria: Real Madrid circulated 'lies' |url=http://www.espnfc.com/barclays-premier-league/story/2005413/manchester-united-signing-angel-di-maria-didnt-want-to-leave-real-madrid-for-premier-league |work=ESPN FC |publisher=ESPN Internet Ventures |date=26 August 2014 |access-date=26 August 2014 }}</ref>

Di María's home in [[Prestbury, Cheshire]], was the scene of an attempted burglary on 31 January 2015.<ref>{{cite news |title=Man Utd's Angel Di Maria house targeted by burglars |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-31088104 |publisher=BBC News (British Broadcasting Corporation) |date=1 February 2015 |access-date=2 February 2015 }}</ref>

On 2 September 2020, it was reported that Di María, along with PSG teammates [[Neymar]] and [[Leandro Paredes]], had tested positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. The French sports newspaper ''[[L'Équipe]]'' said that the three players reportedly went on vacation in [[Ibiza]]. As a result, they had to quarantine for one week, and the rest of the players and working staff were scheduled to take a coronavirus test within the same week.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dw.com/en/sports-news-feed-neymar-tests-positive-for-covid-19-sources-claim/a-54765770|title=Sports news feed: Neymar tests positive for COVID-19 sources claim|publisher=DW News|date=2 September 2020|access-date=4 September 2020}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://soccer.nbcsports.com/2020/09/02/neymar-covid-19-positive-test-psg-coronavirus/|title=Report: Neymar among positive COVID-19 tests at PSG|publisher=NBC Sports|date=2 September 2020|access-date=4 September 2020}}</ref>

During a match between PSG and [[FC Nantes|Nantes]] on 14 March 2021, Di María's home was robbed and his family was held hostage. He had been substituted off the pitch by manager [[Mauricio Pochettino]], who informed Di María of the situation. PSG teammate [[Marquinhos]]' parents' home was also burgled in a similar way.<ref>{{Cite web|date=14 March 2021|title=Di Maria, Marquinhos homes robbed mid-game|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/paris-saint-germain/story/4338468/sources-families-of-psgs-angel-di-mariamarquinhos-held-hostage-during-home-invasions|access-date=15 March 2021|publisher=ESPN}}</ref>

=== Pandora Papers ===
Di María is one of the 13 sports personalities named in the [[Pandora Papers]] published by the [[International Consortium of Investigative Journalists]] (ICIJ). He used a company in [[Panama]] to exploit his image rights for months before arriving at Real Madrid. He is the owner of a company in Panama created especially to manage his million-dollar contracts for the exploitation of his image rights, a shell company that he used since 2009 and that he maintains to this day. The Pandora Papers reveal that he handled more than €8 million between 2013 and 2017 through a company named Sunpex Corporation Inc.<ref>{{Cite web |date=3 October 2021 |title=Pandora Papers {{!}} Di María utilizó una sociedad en Panamá para explotar sus derechos de imagen desde meses antes de llegar al Real Madrid |url=https://www.lasexta.com/pandora-papers/maria-utilizo-sociedad-panama-explotar-sus-derechos-imagen-meses-antes-llegar-real-madrid_202110036159e7343ac97500014e5d8e.html |access-date=24 January 2023 |website=www.lasexta.com |language=es}}</ref>
